login.title: Connect with TackleBox
login.body: Copy the login request and paste it into TackleBox (Contracts → ESR → CONNECT AS LOGIN), or scan the QR code with TackleBox on another device.
login.copied: Request copied. In TackleBox, open Contracts → ESR → CONNECT AS LOGIN and paste it to continue.

transact.title: Sign with TackleBox
transact.body: Review and approve this transaction in TackleBox ("{{channelName}}").
transact.body_manual: Copy the signing request and paste it into TackleBox (Contracts → ESR), or scan the QR code with TackleBox on another device.
transact.copied: Request copied. In TackleBox, open Contracts → ESR and paste it to continue.

error.expired: The request expired, please try again.
error.invalid_response: Invalid response from TackleBox, it must contain the cid, sa and sp fields.
error.cancelled: The request was declined in TackleBox.
